pages.title: Level Once Again(v2)
pages.creator: UltraFlow Games
pages.description: Help Veer rescue Tara in Level Once Again(v2). Each room has a button and door, but the rules change. Watch for tricks like falling floors or a moving exit.

pages.title: 2048 Voxel Worlds
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Slide the 3D board in 2048 Voxel Worlds and merge blocks of equal value. Earn coins from merges and use Swap, Blast, or Rotate to keep the board playable.

pages.title: Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot
pages.creator: Square Dino LLC
pages.description: Sail between islands in Fishing: Catch the Secret Brainrot. Try different fishing spots and see whether the next catch is an ordinary fish or one of the unusual creatures.

pages.title: Number Place Travel
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Place digits in Number Place Travel so every row, column, and three-by-three box has no repeats. Tap a cell to enter a number and use the three-mistake allowance carefully.

pages.title: Police Traffic Racer
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Take police cars onto busy highways in Police Traffic Racer. Steer around traffic at speed and try the different modes and road environments without crashing.

pages.title: Steal Brainrot Original 3D
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Collect creatures and put them to work in your base in Steal Brainrot Original 3D. Start with basic animals and use the income they generate to go after rarer ones.

pages.title: Tap It Away 3D
pages.creator: TopKeyGames
pages.description: Tap arrow-marked blocks to slide them out in Tap It Away 3D. Look for pieces with nothing in their path and remove them to free blocks farther in.

pages.title: Pop Star
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Pop groups of two or more matching blocks in Pop Star. Look for larger combinations when you can, since they give you more points and help clear the board.

pages.title: Chicken Math
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Recover Archimedes's numbers in Chicken Math. Take the rifle into the backyard and look for the values he needs instead of shooting at every number you see.

pages.title: Hidden Objects
pages.creator: MorionStudio
pages.description: Search detailed scenes in Hidden Objects. Look for the items on the list and check how their shapes blend into the background. Use a hint when a search stalls.

pages.title: Pretty Sheep Run
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Send a sheep across platforms in Pretty Sheep Run. Dodge traps and aim at numbered doors as you keep the sheep moving down the route.

pages.title: LABUBU MERGE CLICKER
pages.creator: 45thking
pages.description: Merge matching characters in LABUBU MERGE CLICKER. Try to make rarer forms from each pair and leave space for new characters before the box fills.

pages.title: Poopy Escape The Prison
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Poopy break out of a maximum-security prison in Poopy Escape The Prison. Avoid guards and check for hidden passages as you solve the puzzles between cells.

pages.title: Buckshot Roulette
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Make choices under pressure in Buckshot Roulette. Consider each turn before pulling the shotgun's trigger as you try to survive the showdown against your opponent.

pages.title: Park Them All!
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Drive and park cars in Park Them All! Work through the parking challenges and the game's math puzzles as you move from one layout to another.

pages.title: Makeup Trends: Then And Now
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Style Kiki through changing beauty trends in Makeup Trends: Then And Now. Experiment with early-2000s looks and more recent styles such as emo and Euphoria-inspired makeup.

pages.title: Crash the Robot!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Use objects from your inventory in Crash the Robot! Arrange them in the level, start the chain reaction, and work out what it takes to break the robot.

pages.title: Hole Battle.io
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Grow a hole by swallowing smaller objects in Hole Battle.io. Start with what fits, then look for bigger items as you expand. Stay away from holes that can swallow yours.

pages.title: Gin Rummy
pages.creator: RedFoc
pages.description: Arrange a hand into sets and runs in Gin Rummy. Group cards of the same rank or make consecutive sequences in one suit to reduce the cards left over.

pages.title: Tap 3 Mahjong
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Collect three matching tiles in Tap 3 Mahjong. Check what is available and clear groups as you work through boards decorated with classic mahjong symbols.

pages.title: Halloween Head Soccer
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Pick a Halloween character in Halloween Head Soccer. Try to score more goals than the opponent before time expires, either solo or in the two-player mode.

pages.title: Squirrel Hero
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Protect a tree from aliens in Squirrel Hero. Send the squirrels leaping onto the invaders and choose where to strike before the attackers reach their home.

pages.title: Tiny Blocks
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Clear groups of identical tiles in Tiny Blocks. Bigger groups give you power-ups, while taking a single block costs points. Work out how to remove everything.

pages.title: Throw Knife 3D
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Throw knives to climb the column in Throw Knife 3D. Hold to attack and time your shots so you move upward without hitting the stickman.

pages.title: Tile Connect - Pair Matching
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Look for matching pairs in Tile Connect - Pair Matching. Select tiles you can link and plan which pair will open a path for another one.

pages.title: Restoration Master
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Run a workshop in Restoration Master. Bring old items back into shape, from candlesticks to rare knives, and see how each object changes as you work on it.

pages.title: Rocket Fest
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Steer through higher-numbered lanes in Rocket Fest and collect more rockets along the way. Build up enough firepower to destroy the tank waiting at the end.

pages.title: Teeth Runner!
pages.creator: GameBake Ltd
pages.description: Brush teeth as you run in Teeth Runner! Look at who is next in line and pick the right ingredient for humans, zombies, vampires, and the other patients.

pages.title: Stick Fight Combo
pages.creator: BotaGame
pages.description: Fight along side-scrolling streets in Stick Fight Combo. Use attacks to handle the opponents in your path and adjust your timing as the action moves forward.

pages.title: Crowd Pusher
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Gather matching characters and numbers in Crowd Pusher. Build a stronger crowd along the platform so you have enough people to take on the boss.

pages.title: Shooting Star Battleship
pages.creator: Smartline-Games
pages.description: Defend your world in Shooting Star Battleship. Steer away from meteors, shoot enemy ships, and spend what you earn on upgrades for the next encounter.

pages.title: Brick Breaker
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Slide to launch balls at the blocks in Brick Breaker. Collect more balls to improve later volleys and clear the harder blocks before they reach you.

pages.title: Monster Soccer 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Choose a monster in Monster Soccer 3D and knock the ball toward the goal with its hands. Play with another person or include bots in the match.

pages.title: Hula Hoops Rush
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Gather hoops that match your runner in Hula Hoops Rush. Slide to steer toward the right colors and avoid the lava as you try to carry more hoops.

pages.title: Mermaid Wonders Hidden Object
pages.creator: Origaming Media
pages.description: Search hand-painted underwater scenes in Mermaid Wonders Hidden Object. Scan each picture for the objects you're asked to find and click them when you spot them.

pages.title: Mine Tap
pages.creator: Replay10
pages.description: Mine for gems and equipment in Mine Tap. Use the pickaxe and abilities to look for treasure as you explore biomes and build up your crafting supplies.

pages.title: Ring Challenge
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Guide a ring along a rod in Ring Challenge. Keep it from touching the rod and pick up gems on the way to unlock more rings.

pages.title: TRZ Athletic Games
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Try ten track and field events in TRZ Athletic Games. Use the keyboard or touchscreen to time runs, jumps, and throws in events such as hurdles and javelin.

pages.title: Stop Them All
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Trigger traps as the group reaches them in Stop Them All. Wait until the timing is right, then tap Activate to set the next obstacle in motion.

pages.title: T Rally
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Drive a rally car in T Rally and take out the enemies on the track. Use WASD to steer and unlock other vehicles as you complete missions.

pages.title: Stacker Tower
pages.creator: GuiGhost LLC
pages.description: Drop boxes onto a growing stack in Stacker Tower. Watch the position of the next box and release it when it lines up with the one below.

pages.title: Happy Easter Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble nine Easter pictures in Happy Easter Puzzle. Pick an image and choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, then match edges and colors to restore the scene.

pages.title: Exploder.io
pages.creator: PIOTR DAWIDIUK
pages.description: Plant bombs in space-themed mazes in Exploder.io. Clear a path and move away before the blast while you fight rival players and monsters.

pages.title: Candy Burst
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fill candy orders in Candy Burst. Watch how much falls into the container and stop at the target. Too little disappoints the customer, and too much costs money.

pages.title: Machine Gun Squad
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight your way toward the leader of an armed group in Machine Gun Squad. Use the weapons in airdrops when you need more firepower to get through.

pages.title: Christmas 2020 Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Match holiday items in Christmas 2020 Match 3 Deluxe. Work toward each level's target and use bombs, hourglasses, or special jolly pieces when they help.

pages.title: Guess the Color
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Look at the pencil in Guess the Color and decide whether the named color matches. Answer yes or no quickly and try to get as many right as possible.

pages.title: Shoot or Die
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Wait for the signal in Shoot or Die, then fire before your opponent does. Keep your timing sharp as the game lines up more computer-controlled gunslingers.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Insects
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find insects and other items in Hidden Objects Insects. Check the list on the left and click each item in the picture before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Princess Wedding Planner
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Plan a wedding with Anna in Princess Wedding Planner. Get Elsa ready for the ceremony and help prepare the details for her celebration with Jack.

pages.title: Desserts Coloring Game
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Color desserts in Desserts Coloring Game. Use the mouse to try different shades on cakes, ice cream, and sweets, then pick a new drawing when you're done.

pages.title: Racing Cars Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Build pictures of competition cars in Racing Cars Puzzle. Choose from six images and four piece counts, using paint and body details to join pieces.

pages.title: Opel GT Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore six Opel GT pictures in Opel GT Puzzle. Pick a layout from sixteen to a hundred pieces and work from the car's outline or the edges.

pages.title: Casino Royale
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description: Spin virtual reels in Casino Royale. Start a round and look at the symbols that line up after the spin, then try another turn in the slot-machine simulator.

pages.title: High Jump
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Time a leap onto each moving platform in High Jump. Watch the direction and speed of the next piece before you jump, then keep stacking the platforms.

pages.title: Funny Easter Jigsaw
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Put together an Easter scene in Funny Easter Jigsaw. Use the mouse to move pieces and compare their shapes and colors to find the joins.

pages.title: Slap King
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Time your slap in Slap King. Aim for a strong hit and watch how the opponent responds before taking your next turn in the contest.

pages.title: Color Square
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Switch the big square's color in Color Square. Match the smaller squares before they arrive, because a collision with the wrong color ends the run.

pages.title: Off The Hook Pro
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Turn a bent metal shape in Off The Hook Pro. Use A and D or the arrows and control the angle so the rings slide into the hole.

pages.title: Cartoon Ambulance Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange tiles in Cartoon Ambulance Slide. Choose from three pictures and three modes and look for parts of the cartoon vehicle that line up across tiles.

pages.title: Super Sliding Santa
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Guide Santa's sled in Super Sliding Santa and look for a clear route ahead. Collect coins and spend them on accessories before your next ride.

pages.title: Monster Ball
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Help a round creature collect snacks in Monster Ball. Watch the cannon above the platform and move to catch what falls while keeping the monster alive.

pages.title: Bike Racing Math
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Solve arithmetic problems to accelerate in Bike Racing Math. Choose the correct result to gain speed and avoid mistakes that slow the motorcycle down.

pages.title: Kiko Adventure
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Gather fruit and bottles in Kiko Adventure. Move with the arrows or touch controls, collecting fruit for points and bottles to open more levels.

pages.title: Hyper Soccer Shoot Training
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Swipe to bend free kicks in Hyper Soccer Shoot Training. Aim through the goal and adjust the curve when you need a different line to the net.

pages.title: Chinese New Year Mahjong
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Find matching tiles in Chinese New Year Mahjong. Use the tutorial to learn the rules, then pair the designs and work through the holiday boards.

pages.title: Easter Memory
pages.creator: NoticeGames.com
pages.description: Match cards before the clock runs out in Easter Memory. Turn over two at a time and remember where each picture is to finish the remaining pairs.

pages.title: TomatoRunner
pages.creator: sienar games
pages.description: Jump over enemies and obstacles in TomatoRunner. Use the keyboard controls to move and time your jumps so you can keep the tomato moving through the route.

pages.title: City Ambulance Driving
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Take an emergency vehicle through driving levels in City Ambulance Driving. Use WASD and give the ambulance room to steer as you approach the next turn.

pages.title: Snow Plow Jeep Simulator 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Clear snow from winter roads in Snow Plow Jeep Simulator 3D. Drive the plow through the area and work on the stretches where snowfall has made travel difficult.

pages.title: xDrive iPerformance Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble photos of the xDrive concept in xDrive iPerformance Puzzle. Pick one of six pictures and a piece count, then fit the vehicle and scenery together.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Valentines Day
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Help Hazel celebrate with her family in Baby Hazel Valentines Day. Work through the preparations she and her grandfather make before her parents come home.

pages.title: Highway Bus Driver Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Transport passengers in Highway Bus Driver Simulator. Take the bus through city and highway routes and adjust your speed as the road and traffic change.

pages.title: Cell War
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Drag to steer a ship in Cell War. Fire at cells with the ship's weapons and move to line up another target as you clear them.

pages.title: Real Snakes.io
pages.creator: BRAVO
pages.description: Grow your snake in Real Snakes.io while keeping its head clear of rival players. Look for space to turn before you get boxed in by another snake.

pages.title: Jeff The Killer VS Slendrina
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Choose Jeff or Slendrina in Jeff The Killer VS Slendrina. Explore the map from a third-person view and face your rival as you work through the fight.

pages.title: Hopping Boys
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide the runner through platforming obstacles in Hopping Boys. Use the mouse and time your hops to clear the next gap or hazard.

pages.title: Beach House Cleaning
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Tidy a sandy home in Beach House Cleaning. Vacuum the floors and put clothes away before finishing the other chores around the rooms.

pages.title: EG One Line
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Solve each shape in one stroke in EG One Line. Decide where to start and how to get around the pattern without needing to lift the line.

pages.title: Blob Tank Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Fire blobs from a tank in Blob Tank Wars. Play against the computer or a friend, and choose your shots as you work through five chapters.

pages.title: Shooting Range Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Practice hitting targets in Shooting Range Simulator. Take time to aim at the range and adjust where you point the weapon based on each shot.

pages.title: Flappy Super Kitty
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Fly a superhero cat through space in Flappy Super Kitty. Flap past the obstacles and use abilities like shrinking, shielding, or slow motion to extend your run.

pages.title: Cinema Lovers Hidden Kiss
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Steal a kiss at the movies in Cinema Lovers Hidden Kiss. Watch the people around the couple and stop when someone is about to look their way.

pages.title: Smash all these F... animals
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Tap the animals before they cross the screen in Smash all these F... animals. You start with three health points and lose one when an animal gets through.

pages.title: Sky War
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Fire at targets and dodge danger in Sky War. See how long you can keep the shooter going and try to reach a higher score on another run.

pages.title: Skating Courses
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Pick skating clothes for two sisters in Skating Courses. Choose what each one will wear for her first lesson and compare the finished outfits.

pages.title: Triangle Energy
pages.creator: MDV Games
pages.description: Link three matching gems in Triangle Energy. The energy chain also clears gems it crosses, so choose an angle that reaches the pieces the level asks for.

pages.title: Australian Patience
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Move cards to four suit foundations in Australian Patience. Build from ace to king while working with the face-up cards in the seven columns.

pages.title: Christmas Breaker Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Clear matching blocks in Christmas Breaker Game. Remove groups of two or more and look for another match before clicking, since a single block costs a life.

pages.title: Crazy Mommy Beauty Salon
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Give a busy mother a salon break in Crazy Mommy Beauty Salon. Start with a manicure and work through the other treatments as she takes time for herself.

pages.title: Poultry ACE Downhill
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pick a driver and track in Poultry ACE Downhill. Steer past obstacles and see how far you can make it down the hill without crashing.

pages.title: Princess Faceswap
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Swap features among princesses and villains in Princess Faceswap. Choose different faces and see how the characters look after you combine their features.

pages.title: Monster High Christmas
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help Abbey Bominable prepare the holiday party in Monster High Christmas. Work through what she needs to get ready before the other ghouls arrive.

pages.title: Princess Christmas Selfie
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Choose holiday outfits for the princesses in Princess Christmas Selfie. Put together a themed look for each one before they go shopping and take their picture.

pages.title: Flying Farm
pages.creator: Chilican
pages.description: Manage tasks with Barney in Flying Farm to bring a baby star home. Work through locations in the sky, below the ocean, and on a volcano.

pages.title: Mermaid Princess Wedding Day
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Prepare the wedding party in Mermaid Princess Wedding Day. Style the bridesmaids and then choose how the mermaid bride will look for the ceremony.
